title: Finite lisse etale sheaves have finite local module values in the explicit small model
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], k any commutative ring and F a finite locally constant k-module sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant]. Its explicit coefficient model sfbEtaleResidueModel [lem-sfb-adic-immersion-residue-transport] is locally constant with finite type module values [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules]. Consequently the cohomology of sfbImmersionResidue is locally constant of finite type when each inverse-image cohomology sheaf of C is finite locally constant. Neither finiteness of the underlying ring nor boundedness of C is required.

proof.text: Discard empty members of a locally constant cover. A geometric point on each remaining member identifies its constant module value with a geometric stalk. Finite stalks mean finitely generated modules, without requiring the coefficient ring finite.

Apply the preceding cover to the inverse image of F on each etale object. Convert these trivializations to covering sieves; use exact etale and slice equivalences to retain each constant module value. Transport the sieve through AsSmall and the normalized scalar-restriction equivalence, including the commutative/ring coefficient comparison.
Use exact inverse image and exact coefficient transport to commute with homology, then transport each local trivialization through the homology isomorphism.
